Extensions.ExtractScript:
param([xml]$Document)
# Writes every <File> below to the path in its path attribute, as UTF-8 with a byte order mark so Windows # PowerShell 5.1 reads any non-ASCII text in it correctly. foreach ($File in $Document.unattend.Extensions.File) { $Path = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($File.GetAttribute('path')) New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $Path) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null $Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true) [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $File.InnerText.Trim(), $Encoding) }
